#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>

int main() {
    int n, b;
    std::cin >> n >> b;
    std::vector<int> array(n);
    std::vector<int> prefixSum(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> array[i];
    }
    int balanceCount = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (array[i] % 2 == 0)
            ++balanceCount;
        else
            --balanceCount;
        prefixSum[i] = balanceCount;
    }
    std::vector<int> diffList;
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
        if (prefixSum[i] == 0)
            diffList.push_back(std::abs(array[i] - array[i + 1]));
    }
    std::sort(diffList.begin(), diffList.end());
    int totalCuts = 0, accumulated = 0;
    for (int diff : diffList) {
        if (accumulated + diff <= b) {
            accumulated += diff;
            ++totalCuts;
        }
        if (accumulated >= b)
            break;
    }
    std::cout << totalCuts;
    return 0;
}
